note: Rows NBA.com's game logs carry that the record books don't, each with the receipt that says so. Applied by scripts/build-history.mjs before its own ghost-row pass. A drop names the date, the team code of the day and the NBA person id.

drop.name: Dolph Schayes
drop.note: An 11-point row that duplicates Lee Shaffer's line (5 FG, 1 FT, 2 reb) in the same game; Basketball-Reference's 1961-62 log has no Schayes game that day.

drop.name: George Mikan
drop.note: Ed Mikan's Rochester opener filed under George's id, before George's first Minneapolis game of the season, so the wedged-row rule can't see it; Basketball-Reference's 1950-51 log for George starts Nov 1 at Baltimore.

tiebreakersNote: Playoff tiebreaker games of 1947 to 1957 that NBA.com's log types as regular season; Basketball-Reference and the record books count them as postseason (Pettit's 792 games and 20,880 points, Johnny Kerr's 844 straight games). They move to the playoffs here.
